description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseClusterEntity' used within the Orleans framework for clustering with CosmosDB. It includes properties for cluster identification and a method for entity type, serving as a foundational class for cluster-related entities.

classes.name: BaseClusterEntity
classes.description: Abstract base class for cluster entities, extending 'BaseEntity', with properties for cluster identification and entity type.

methods.name: EntityType
methods.description: Abstract property that derived classes must implement to specify the type of entity.
